events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, first went on air, broadcasting "Video Killed The Radio Star" by The Buggles as its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Today marks the launch of MTV, a channel that revolutionised how we consumed music.

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994, featuring classics like "Supersonic" and "Live Forever."

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. Still sounds as fresh and defiant as ever, doesn't it?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture, began in upstate New York in 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of "The King of Rock and Roll," Elvis Presley, who died in 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years on, the influence of Elvis Presley is still undeniable. His music continues to move generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop world remembers the tragic death of iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, who passed away in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's lyrics and impact resonate just as powerfully today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who died in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' featuring iconic tracks and its famous cover art, in 1969.

angles.name: Crossing Abbey Road
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Oasis and rock icon, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still a rock 'n' roll star.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem "Imagine" as a single in 1975, originally from his 1971 album of the same name.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single. Its message of peace and unity remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its revolutionary portable digital music player, the iPod, forever changing how we listen to music, in 2001.

angles.name: The Click Wheel Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the feeling of that click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' introduced us to 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers the life and legacy of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album,' in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your favourite track?
